These are repairable method defects that should be corrected before fresh claim-bearing outputs.
findings: The unchanged FLASH solver/reader was commissioned by an end-to-end anchor evolution, and the wrapper carries forward the intended 2D geometry, uniform eta, grids, four-rank limit, and dual-flux observable; the anchor itself remains permanently non-evidentiary and cannot support scaling.

campaign_case.py records max divB, mass and energy drift, and minimum density/pressure, but applies no decision thresholds to them and omits helper numerical_regime from its failure checks; conservation and floor accounting is therefore not admissibility-bearing as declared.
analyze_only states a two-sided residual-bootstrap 95% falsification rule but implements no bootstrap, so the declared whole-interval falsifier cannot be executed as written.

The newly changed downstream wrapper has not itself completed a fresh end-to-end qualification run; a small commissioning case is required after the relevant source change, not the full eight-case production matrix.

No fresh production case has yet run, no experiment is active, and there is no repeated polling or missing-case concealment. With about 137 seconds remaining versus a 170-second protocol estimate, completing the full campaign and review is unlikely; partial outcomes must be reported honestly rather than extrapolated.
verdict.next_action: Patch the analyzer to enforce the declared numerical-regime, conservation, and floor thresholds and implement or explicitly restate the bootstrap rule, then run one fresh 128x128 base case as wrapper commissioning; if time expires, record the result as unresolved with exact receipts.

findings: The declared model, geometry, four-rank decomposition, explicit uniform resistivity path, and exact anchor command match the supplied instrument scope; this review does not authorize any claim about the exponent or Sweet-Parker branch.

The implemented diagnostic checks both flux-line paths, fixed crossing thresholds, realized eta and grid, state finiteness and positivity, divB, boundary contamination, path mismatch, and initial sheet-cell resolution, with explicit numerical thresholds.

The earlier reproduce-anchor command exited with status 1 before the run; this is an observed invocation/harness failure, not evidence of a FLASH physics failure, and subsequent inspection and method registration followed without repeated polling.
The snapshot reports zero fresh experiments, so operator validation and prior anchor labels remain non-evidentiary and do not establish current readiness.
The instrument limitation remains material: one resistivity, one 128x128 grid, one finite flux window, no refinement, no plasmoid/topology diagnostic, and no scaling measurement.
verdict.next_action: Execute the registered instrument as one fresh experiment using the exact supplied anchor command, then inspect the generated machine checks and receipt before treating the instrument as commissioned.
